Buyer Added text based ATC clauses As per GeM bid condition "Benefits of MSE will be allowed only it the credentials of the service provider are validated on-line in GeM profile as well as validated and approved by the Buyer after evaluation of submitt ed documents" i.e. as per GeM bid condition, benefits of MSE for EMD exemption, for MSE purchase prefere nce etc. will be allowed only if the credentials of the service provider are validated online as well as validat ed and approved by the Buyer after evaluation of submitted documents. In case any bidder submits documents for benefits of MSE but for MSE benefits, the credentials of the servi ce provider/bidder are not found validated on-line, then as per GeM bid condition offer of such bidder will n ot be allowed for benefits of MSE i.e. benefits of MSE for EMD exemption, of MSE purchase preference etc. .
